# Morning check — kiel-01

Run this top to bottom before the doors open. It prints one
`evt=` line for the shift log and leaves the queue depth on
screen for whoever is standing at the till.

Create the <open-orders> with 19.
Log "evt=morning-check shop=kiel-01 open=${<open-orders>}" to the <console>.
Compute the <shift-state: uppercase> from "backlog".

Nineteen open orders at 07:40 is over the twelve the kitchen
display can hold. The next cell measures the gap, and it has
never been run in this file — no outputs, no execution count,
which is exactly how a notebook ships before anyone opens it.
